snippet.title: Foundlings - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784610/Foundlings/

Foundlings is a spellcasting RPG set in 12th-century England during the Revolt of 1173. It is the first project by game development studio Maypole Games.

Twitter: https://x.com/MaypoleGames
